title: Torsion and curvature of ACYT and AHKT 8-manifold
summary: We observe that on a compact almost Hermitian 8 manifold with totally skew-symmetric Nijenhuis tensor parallel with respect to the unique almost hermitian connection with torsion three form if the three Ricci tensors of this connection vanish then the torsion 3-form is closed. Consequently, on a compact complex 8-manifold if the three Ricci tensors of the Strominger-Bismut connection vanish then its torsion is closed, i.e. the space is pluriclosed.
